name: @vesper/astro
description: The Vesper integration for Astro: the studio at /admin, schema helpers and config.
//exports: @vesper/source points workspace tooling at TypeScript source; everyone else gets dist/. "." is the integration (astro add); ./node is Node-only (config loading, manifest, local storage). ./components is and getImg(), shipped as source for the site's Astro to compile, like pages/; ./images is their planning. ./image-service is the crop step around Astro's Sharp image service, registered by the integration (spec §6.6.5).
//files: pages/ holds the injected /admin page and components/ the component; src/ and dist/ both resolve pages at ../../pages.
//dependencies: axe-core runs the build's accessibility checks (spec §6.18, layer 2), the same engine as the e2e suite; jsdom is the DOM it runs in without a browser, matched against Chromium (DECISIONS.md). Both load only in astro:build:done.
//peerDependencies: The site's own Astro: schemas, loaders and Zod must come from the same copy the site builds with (spec §6.3). React is the studio's, shared with the site's custom widgets (spec §6.3.3). sharp is the copy Astro's own image service already loads; the crop step needs it too, and optional because a site without Astro's Sharp service never loads the crop step. lucide resolves the icons collections name in vesper.config.ts, at build; optional because a site that names none needn't install it.
//devDependencies: Tailwind compiles the studio stylesheet from source in this workspace only; published sites get dist/studio.css.
